column1: # handoffs.tsv -- files this repo has handed to their owner, and the PR that
# receives each one. Read by bin/reprise.sh and by nothing else.
# THE RULE THIS TABLE EXISTS TO ENFORCE (realisateur#368): "Deletion on this
# side lands only after the receiving PR merges. A draft is not a delivery, and
# a file deleted here before it exists there is an outage."
# That rule was written down in an issue body and then carried out by hand,
# which is the shape this estate keeps failing at -- the senechal block moved
# on 2026-08-22 and the deletion here was still owed four days later. A row
# below is the same promise, in a form a clock can act on.
# Columns:  path here  TAB  receiving repo  TAB  receiving PR number  TAB  path there
# `path there` is checked on the RECEIVING REPO'S DEFAULT BRANCH, not on the
# PR's branch. A merged PR whose file is not there is a FAILURE, never a
# collection: squash-merges get reverted, paths get renamed in review, and a
# merge is a fact about a pull request rather than about a tree.
# consigne -> hf7y/bibliothecaire, which owns lib/consign-prose.sh and bin/fonde.
# NOT a relocation: consigne was a 559-line forwarder to that mechanism with
# zero callers estate-wide. bibliothecaire#68 carries the one capability it
# added -- `consigne status` -- back as `fonde consign --report`. The witness
# is bin/fonde on bibliothecaire's default branch, so these rows collect only
# once the report is actually there to replace what they remove.
# PAUSED 2026-09-02 (realisateur#879 follow-up): "zero callers estate-wide" is
# false today -- bin/consigne is still PAYLOAD in propagation-set.sh, still
# shipped, and bin/vault-group-provision.sh runs `command -v consigne` at
# apply time; hooks/pretooluse-path-guard.sh allowlists the name. --apply
# deleted it anyway and broke propagation.test.sh/defere-scan.test.sh on a
# green main. Uncomment once every local caller points at `fonde` instead.
# bin/consigne
# man/consigne.1
# bin/tests/consigne.test.sh
# monkey-watch and its parts -> hf7y/senechal, which owns what exists on a
# host and already received the three monkey provisioning scripts (senechal#355).
# Carried WITH #621 (the vmhost seam) and #639 (the virtual clock) already in.
# The witness for each is the file on senechal's default branch; the dexter
# crontab line is retargeted at merge time, which is why these must not
# collect on the merge alone.
# provision/dexter/README.md is NOT a row. It went to the VAULT, not to
# senechal -- a plan proposed 2026-08-14 on empty ground and never executed,
# now at vault:senechal/dexter-host-layout-20260814.md with its actionable
# half at senechal#439. A deposit is not a handoff, so it is deleted here
# outright rather than waited on.
# PR 441 was closed unmerged, superseded by 513, then 520, then 522 (rebases
# past prose-ratchet unit-2 fallout, senechal#442). reprise checks `merged` on
# the literal PR number in this row, so a superseded number reports OWED
# forever even after the real successor merges -- retarget this row on every
# supersession, not just once (hf7y/realisateur#651).
# PAUSED 2026-09-02 (realisateur#879 follow-up): bin/repose.sh still sources
# lib/vmhost.sh at runtime (". $HERE/lib/vmhost.sh", not a copy); ausculte.sh,
# cron-invoked.tsv and not-a-verb.tsv still read monkey-watch.sh and
# monkey-status-collect.py as local files. --apply deleted all nine anyway and
# broke cron-lock/estate-set/propagation and 15 extra repose.test.sh failures
# on a green main. Uncomment once repose.sh and propagation-set.sh point at
# senechal's copies instead of these paths -- #651 stays open until then.
# THAT BLOCKER IS SPENT; A WORSE ONE REPLACED IT (measured 2026-09-18).
# senechal now carries bin/lib/{vmhost,cron-lock,zaxon,monkey-watch-alert}.sh
# and monkey-watch-merge.py, so "point at senechal's copies" is satisfied. But
# every copy over there is from 2026-09-01 and the estate moved:
#   bin/lib/vmhost.sh            senechal  94 lines   realisateur 257
#                                and the word `wsl` appears ZERO times in it
#   bin/monkey-watch.sh          senechal 143 lines   realisateur ~300
#   bin/monkey-status-collect.py senechal 168 lines   realisateur 364
# senechal's vmhost.sh is the pre-migration VirtualBox-only driver. Hand repose
# over onto it and it reads `unknown` for monkey forever, because monkey has
# been a WSL2 distro since 2026-08-30. THE HANDOFF IS A RE-SYNC, NOT A MOVE:
# senechal's five files have to be brought to realisateur's current versions
# first, or this delivers a mechanism to a driver that cannot see the host.
# bin/monkey-watch.sh
# bin/monkey-status-collect.py
# bin/lib/monkey-watch-alert.sh
# bin/lib/monkey-watch-merge.py
# bin/lib/vmhost.sh
# share/monkey-status.html
# bin/tests/monkey-watch.test.sh
# bin/tests/vmhost.test.sh
# bin/tests/monkey-status-collect.test.sh
# the self-dev provisioning block -> hf7y/scheduler, which owns arming and
# dispatch (ROSTER, dose, usage-gate.sh, sync-crontab.sh). realisateur#577
# measured it: 1,453 lines provisioning an account about five times a year.
# bin/ and bin/lib/ here become bin/ and lib/ THERE (scheduler's layout), and
# bin/tests/ becomes tests/ -- so the destination column is not a mirror of
# the left one. That is the whole reason this column exists rather than being
# derived from the path.
# wire-release-channel.sh is NOT a row and stays here: it installs
# /usr/local/libexec/selfdev, and the set it installs includes THIS repo's
# ausculte probes. scheduler's lib/provision-set.sh declares it as a step
# dresse runs without claiming to own the file.
# PAUSED 2026-08-29 (realisateur#577 follow-up): #312 merged into scheduler

# reprise only checks that `there` EXISTS on scheduler's default branch, not
